cohort: 654 pregnant mothers who gave birth in Azady Teaching Hospital in Kirkuk city, with 218 women aged 14 to 19 years (case group) and 436 women between 20 and 34 years (control group).
finding: Teenage mothers were more liable to complications during pregnancy and labor and delivery compared to adult mothers.
mod_finding: Teenage mothers had a higher rate of induced labor and normal delivery with episiotomy compared to adult mothers.
